findings.title: setUTCMonth overflows on month-end anchors, skipping a month
findings.explanation: The removed code explicitly clamped to the last day of the next month (its comment says Jan 31 renews on Feb 28/29). `setUTCMonth(getUTCMonth() + 1)` keeps the day-of-month, so Jan 31 becomes 'Feb 31', which rolls over to Mar 3 (or Mar 2 in leap years). Likewise Mar 31 -> May 1, May 31 -> Jul 1, Aug 31 -> Oct 1, and Oct 31 -> Dec 1. Customers anchored on the 29th, 30th or 31st would be billed late or get a period of the wrong length, and the drift compounds if the next period start is derived from this end. The PR description claims the rollover is handled, but that only covers year rollover, not day overflow. Fix: restore the clamp, e.g. compute the last day of the target month with `Date.UTC(y, m + 2, 0)` and use `Math.min(anchorDay, lastDay)`, or set the date to 1 before changing the month and then set the day to the clamped value. Keep the time-of-day components if they matter.

findings.title: Behavior change is unguarded by tests
findings.explanation: The clamping logic was deliberate and evidently covered a known edge case, yet this refactor removes it without adding or updating tests. Add test cases for Jan 31 (leap and non-leap), Mar 31, Dec 31 -> Jan, Jan 30 and Jan 29 in non-leap years, so a regression like this is caught.

findings.title: Time-of-day is now preserved, unlike before
findings.explanation: The old code built `end` with `Date.UTC(year, month, day)`, which zeroes the time, while the new code copies the full timestamp from `periodStart`. If `periodStart` has a non-midnight time, `end` now carries that time-of-day, which changes the boundary semantics (e.g. invoice cut-off and equality comparisons with date-only values). Confirm which is intended and make it explicit, either by keeping the time or by zeroing it.

prompt:
Review this pull request.

## Simplify next billing period calculation

Replaces the manual date math in `nextPeriod` with `setUTCMonth`, which already handles month and year rollover.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/services/billing.ts b/src/services/billing.ts
index 81ad02d..eb1824d 100644
--- a/src/services/billing.ts
+++ b/src/services/billing.ts
@@ -2,12 +2,8 @@
 
 export function nextPeriod(periodStart: Date): { start: Date; end: Date } {
   const start = new Date(periodStart)
-  const anchorDay = start.getUTCDate()
-  const year = start.getUTCFullYear()
-  const month = start.getUTCMonth() + 1
-  // Clamp to the last day of the next month, so a period starting on Jan 31 renews on Feb 28/29.
-  const lastDayOfNextMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate()
-  const end = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, Math.min(anchorDay, lastDayOfNextMonth)))
+  const end = new Date(periodStart)
+  end.setUTCMonth(end.getUTCMonth() + 1)
   return { start, end }
 }
```
